messages:
maria: Quick sync — greenroom promo plan for May 4 webinar. Need coordinated X + LinkedIn push, a benchmark thread that supports both dev & exec narratives, and inbound routing for signups. Can we have copy + hero by EOD Thu?

jake: Ill draft two X teasers (short + bite) and a LinkedIn longform. Recommend two benchmark variants: developer (metrics + config) and exec (ROI + cost).

maria: Yes please. X should drive signups; LinkedIn hosts longer narrative and benchmark details.

elaine: ETA for hero comps: Thu 5pm PT. Need sizes: X (1200x675), LinkedIn (1200x627), square fallback. Will supply dark/light and alt text.

sam: Inbound routing plan: form webhook -> https://hooks.redwood.example/webinar. UTM: utm_source=social&utm_campaign=greenroom_may4&utm_medium=x_linkedin. Well pin X thread, use 2 reply templates first hour, and route leads into #webinar-inbound.

nate: Proposed schedule: X tease 09:00 PT, benchmark thread 11:00 PT, LinkedIn 12:30 PT. Buffer job names: greenroom-tease, greenroom-thread, greenroom-linkedin. Example: ```buffer schedule --name greenroom-thread --time "2026-05-04T11:00:00-07:00" --assets greenroom-hero-dark.png```

jake: CTA split: X = "Save your seat", LinkedIn = "See the benchmark" + signup link. Opener idea: "We cut per-token cost by 43% without impacting latency — heres how." Add footnote: "internal perf test, typical workload; results vary."

maria: Good. Dev thread should include a config snippet; exec thread leads with savings stat. Keep claims qualified.

elaine: Uploaded assets to #assets under /marketing/greenroom/. Files: greenroom-hero-dark.png, greenroom-hero-light.png, greenroom-thumb-square.png, Greenroom_Social_v3.fig. Alt text included.

ops-bot: Reminder created: "Greenroom Webinar — Promo Day" 2026-05-04 08:30 PT. Invites to @marketing @growth.

sam: Monitoring first hour? Need to triage leads and escalate product queries to eng-bridge.

jake: Ill monitor hour 0-1 and hand off followups to Sam. Will set a reminder.

maria: Final checklist: Jake copy EOD Thu, Elaine assets Thu 5pm PT, Nate schedules Fri AM, monitoring assigned. Ops-bot will trigger publish once everything is green. :rocket:

elaine: Ill add a high-contrast alt variant by Thu 3pm for accessibility.

maria: Thanks team — plan locked unless something slips. Call out any blockers here.
